spans.title: The Story of the Door
spans.blurb: Out on a walk, a gentleman points to a shabby door and tells of a trampled child, a hateful stranger, and a cheque signed with an unmentionable name.

spans.title: The Juggernaut
spans.blurb: Three in the morning, streets empty and lamplit, a lone walker longing for the sight of a policeman. Then two figures collide at a corner.

spans.title: Mr. Seek
spans.blurb: A lawyer keeps watch on a shabby door by every light and hour, determined to see the face of a man he has never met.

books.pairNote: These two do not overlap each other, but the short duplicates a stretch inside book 42's story span, since 42 and 43 are editions of the same novel.

spans.title: Call Me Cordelia
spans.blurb: Asked her name, a small orphan opens negotiations instead: she pleads for an elegant alias, and failing that, for one crucial letter.

spans.title: The Raspberry Cordial
spans.blurb: Keeping house for the first time, a talkative girl pours her best friend generous tumblerfuls of raspberry cordial and chatters on, not noticing anything amiss.

spans.title: More Gravy Than Grave
spans.blurb: A bitter old man tells the ghost sitting opposite that he does not believe in it, and blames his supper. The spectre listens, perfectly motionless.

spans.title: Fezziwig's Ball
spans.blurb: A spirit leads an old man back to the warehouse where he was apprenticed, just as the shutters go up and a Christmas Eve ball begins.

spans.title: The Cowardly Lion
spans.blurb: A great lion springs at a little dog and gets its nose slapped by a furious little girl. The conversation that follows surprises everyone.

spans.title: The Witch's Silver Whistle
spans.blurb: From her castle door, a witch whose single eye sees everywhere spies four travelers crossing her country. She blows her silver whistle, and wolves come running first.

spans.title: Winning the Watchdog
spans.blurb: A stranger on a strange world sits down beside his fearsome guard beast, puts his arms around its neck, and coaxes it like a hound from home.

spans.title: The Red Star Answers
spans.blurb: For ten years a man has prayed beneath a red star, arms outstretched, begging to be carried back across the void. Tonight something answers.

spans.title: Before the Gates of Kaol
spans.blurb: Waked at dawn by stealthy movement, a lone swordsman spies a silent line of green warriors hidden beside the road, waiting to slaughter a city's unsuspecting troops.

spans.title: Mistress of the Man-Eaters
spans.blurb: Great predators look up from their feast and pad toward two travelers. The man draws his sword; the girl tells him to put it away.

spans.title: Insult in the Royal Garden
spans.blurb: In a royal garden, a prince presses unwanted love on a princess and seizes her arm. Her cry brings the guard, and someone far swifter.

spans.title: The Forest Chapel
spans.blurb: Deep in the forest, arching boughs make a quiet chapel floored with pine needles. A young soldier pushes the green doors aside and steps in.

spans.title: The Tattered Man
spans.blurb: A road streams with wounded men, cursing, singing, staggering to the rear. A boy falls in with the march, and a stranger with a gentle voice keeps pace beside him.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the young soldier has no wound of his own, hinting he ran from the battle.
